value.0: A slab of pale, frost-hardened hide taken from Gorak Vesh, the Icebound, an ancient chirodactyl of Eshan's Silverwood Expanse. Dense ridges and silver scars mark a lifetime of surviving the frozen wilds. Echani hunters prize this unmistakable trophy as proof that the Icebound has fallen.
